title: Airflow Task Duration Anomaly
dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:task`), Airflow StatsD/OTel metrics, dbt `run_results.json`/`sources.json` (`dbt:run_results`), dbt Cloud API run history, Dagster/Prefect run events.
app: Apache Airflow scheduler/worker logs and StatsD/OTel metrics via HEC; dbt run-results/manifest artifacts and dbt Cloud API via HEC scripted inputs; Dagster/Prefect event logs.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=airflow:task state=success
| eval duration_min=round(duration/60,1)
| eventstats avg(duration_min) as avg_min, stdev(duration_min) as sd_min by dag_id, task_id
| eval z=round((duration_min-avg_min)/sd_min,2)
| where z>3
| sort - z
description: Baselines each Airflow task's runtime and flags runs that take far longer than normal, an early sign of data-volume growth or an upstream slowdown.
value: A task that suddenly runs 3x longer warns of growing data or a struggling source before it becomes an SLA miss; anomaly detection catches drift early.
implementation: Ingest successful task durations; schedule daily; tune the z-score threshold. Investigate anomalies with the task owner.
visualization: Table of anomalous runs by z-score, duration trend per task.
grandmaExplanation: We learn how long each data step normally takes and flag when one suddenly takes much longer, an early warning of trouble.
